lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, arranged in a semi-staggered grid pattern starting posterior to the gill slits and extending towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the spot rows, creating a grid-like alignment where the circular blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary linear ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance (top) to low-luminance (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least five distinct, though low-resolution, high-luminance blobs are distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the anterior and central regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A school of small, linear, high-intensity objects (commensal fish) is clustered along the lower lateral flank, partially occluding the ventral-most spot rows.
